answer: Sequential attention decay: each identity must hold a public watch queue on the terrace, answering liveness pings at random intervals. Missed pings delay the queue and reset its trust weight, so sustaining N identities demands N concurrent attention streams. On the lotus pool, only queues with continuous uptime can claim work; a cloned identity must pay a second operator’s full attention budget or fall to the mesa of dormant, unpaid queues within hours.
